test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Prior to which of the following events was the Gandhi-Irwin Pact signed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second Round Table Conference**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Second round table conference:

__
 
• In January 1931 to build a favourable atmosphere for talks, the government lifted the ban on the Congress Party and released its leaders from prison.
 
• On 5 March 1931, the Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed. As per this pact, Mahatma Gandhi agreed to postpone the Civil-Disobedience Movement and participate in the Second Round Table Conference.
 
• In September 1931, the Second Round Table Conference was held in London.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi engaged in the Conference but returned to India misled as no agreement could be reached on the demand for complete independence and the communal question.
 
• In January 1932, the Civil-Disobedience Movement was resumed.
 
• The government reacted to it by arresting Mahatma Gandhi and Sardar Patel and by re-imposing the ban on the Congress party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Round table conference:

 
• The three Round Table Conferences of 1930–32 were a set of peace conferences arranged by the British Government and Indian political personalities to review constitutional reforms in India.
 
• These started in November 1930 and ended in December 1932.
 
• They were administered as per the recommendation of Jinnah to Viceroy Lord Irwin and Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald and by the report submitted by the Simon Commission in May 1930.
